evals.prompt:
Infrahub feels very slow — the UI hangs and a task-worker was OOM-killed
on our Kubernetes deployment (namespace infrahub-prod). Walk me through
collecting a diagnostic bundle for OpsMill support. Do NOT actually run any
commands; write out the exact commands you would run and the steps.
evals.expected_output: A command plan that verifies/installs infrahub-collect, runs `environment detect`, then `infrahub-collect create --benchmark` (K8s namespace targeted), and cautions the user to review the bundle before sharing.
expectations: Recommends `infrahub-collect create`
Includes the `--benchmark` flag for the performance symptom
Surfaces a review-before-sharing caution
Does not resurrect hand-rolled manifest.yml/flags.yml artifacts

assertions.name: review-before-sharing
assertions.check: Plan cautions to review the bundle before sharing

evals.prompt:
My proposed-change pipeline is failing and the repo won't load schemas

evals.prompt:
This afternoon, from about 14:00 to 15:30 UTC, every GraphQL query in
Infrahub took 20 to 30 seconds. It is fast again now. We run Docker Compose
with the observability stack (Tempo and Grafana) turned on. Prepare a
diagnostic bundle for OpsMill support so they can see what was slow. Do NOT
actually run any commands; write out the exact commands and steps.
evals.expected_output: A command plan that asks the operator whether to include the traces of slow requests and confirms the window, then gives `infrahub-collect create --include-traces --traces-start <start> --traces-end <end>` to run after a yes, says that only a share of requests has a trace, and cautions the user to review the bundle before sharing.
expectations: Recommends `infrahub-collect create`
Asks before adding `--include-traces`, and gives `--traces-start` and `--traces-end` for the slowness that ended
Surfaces a review-before-sharing caution
Does not resurrect hand-rolled manifest.yml/flags.yml artifacts

assertions.name: traces-offered-with-window
assertions.check: Plan asks about traces and gives `--include-traces` with `--traces-start` and `--traces-end`

assertions.name: review-before-sharing
assertions.check: Plan cautions to review the bundle before sharing

evals.prompt:
Opening the device list page in Infrahub takes about 40 seconds, every
time, for every user. I can make it happen whenever I want. We run Kubernetes
in the namespace infrahub and have tracing turned on with a low sampling
ratio. I want OpsMill support to see exactly where the time goes. Do NOT
actually run any commands; write out the exact commands and steps.
evals.expected_output: A command plan that asks whether to include traces, tells a super admin to raise the sampling ratio for a limited time with `PUT /api/troubleshooting/trace-sample-ratio` before reproducing the slowness, gives `infrahub-collect create --include-traces --traces-since <window>`, and tells the super admin to remove the temporary ratio with `DELETE` after the bundle is created.
expectations: Asks before adding `--include-traces`, and gives the window options
Raises the sampling ratio for a limited time before reproducing
Removes the temporary ratio after the bundle is created
Leaves the ratio change to the operator rather than running it itself

assertions.name: traces-offered-with-window
assertions.check: Plan asks about traces and gives `--include-traces` with a window

assertions.name: ratio-raise-and-remove
assertions.check: Plan raises the ratio with PUT and removes it with DELETE

evals.prompt:
Infrahub has been very slow for the last hour on our Docker Compose
deployment with the observability stack. You will run the commands for me
through your shell tool, because I am on my phone and cannot type in a
terminal. I have a super_admin API token ready if you need it. Do NOT
actually run any commands yet; write out the exact commands and steps you
will run, and what you need from me.
evals.expected_output: A command plan that asks whether to include traces for the last hour, and says where INFRAHUB_TRACES_API_TOKEN comes from when the agent runs the command: exported before the agent session starts, read from a file the agent never opens, or the operator runs the command themselves. It never asks for the token value in the conversation.
expectations: Asks before adding `--include-traces`, and gives the window options
Says how INFRAHUB_TRACES_API_TOKEN reaches the process the agent runs
Never asks for the token value in the conversation

assertions.name: traces-offered-with-window
assertions.check: Plan asks about traces and gives `--include-traces` with a window

assertions.name: token-env-not-asked
assertions.check: Plan says how INFRAHUB_TRACES_API_TOKEN reaches the command and does not ask for the token value
